apps.name: MindSpace
apps.subtitle: 100% Offline Celestial Meditation
apps.versionDescription: MindSpace 2.0: Major runtime efficiency release featuring sleep sound curation (10m, 30m, 60m), zero-battery-drain animation isolation (breathing aura and constellation pulse), GPU-accelerated starfield, audio hardware deactivation on stop, DateFormatterCache, retained haptics, and sub-millisecond search.
apps.localizedDescription: MindSpace is a zero-network, 100% private offline celestial meditation experience with 275+ hours of mindfulness audio and video courses.

versions.localizedDescription: Curated 10m/30m/60m sleep sounds, zero-battery-drain animation isolation (CelestialBreathingAuraView & ActiveNodeView), GPU starfield rendering, AudioSessionManager hardware deactivation, DateFormatterCache allocations fix, retained haptic generators, and instant pre-indexed catalog search.

Native edge-to-edge resolution fix with LaunchScreen.storyboard, condensed sleep card duration pills ('10 min'), dedicated Mindful Reminder sheet for the bell icon, animated library verification report, and working Preferences toggles.
Fixed background audio on lock screen by adding explicit UIBackgroundModes audio entitlement in Info.plist, enhanced Bluetooth/AirPlay routing, and synchronized lock screen playback state.
Complete UI/UX redesign with UI/UX Pro Max: Celestial breathing visualizer, luminous scrubber, HapticService tactile engine, Cosmic Orbit Hero, living constellation paths, and ambient lighting.
Lock Screen playback & remote control fix, AVAudioSession reactivation, favorite items support, and session reflection persistence.
Full-screen video player, photorealistic planet visuals, background/lock screen audio playback, dynamic daily journey recommendation, daily sleep sounds, and in-progress course filtering.

permissions.usageDescription: Allows meditation audio and sleep sounds to continue playing when the screen is locked or while multitasking.

news.title: MindSpace 2.0 Released
news.caption: Curated 10m/30m/60m sleep sounds, zero battery drain optimizations, isolated breathing & constellation render loops, and instant search.
